features: Fast Wireless Charging Powerbank (15W): Enjoy smooth and reliable wireless charging with up to 15W output—perfect for powering your smartphone without cables.
10,000mAh Slim Magnetic Wireless Powerbank: High-capacity 10000mAh battery ensures long-lasting backup with secure magnetic wireless charging for MagSafe-supported phones.
22.5W PD Wired + Wireless Combo Charging: Get the best of both worlds—superfast 22.5W PD wired charging along with efficient wireless charging on the go.
Detachable Type-C Cable Included: Comes with an in-built detachable Type-C to Type-C cable, giving you multiple ways to charge—wired or wireless charging whenever needed.
Strong Magnetic Hold for Wireless Charging: Designed with a powerful magnetic ring that locks onto your device and ensures steady, drop-free wireless charging.
LED Indicator for Battery & Wireless Charging Status: Stay updated with a clear LED indicator that shows battery levels and wireless charging mode at a glance.
Ultra-Slim 16mm Design for Travel: Lightweight and pocket-friendly slim design makes this the ideal wireless charging powerbank for travel, office, and daily use.
